summary: Almonty Industries filed a Form 6-K reporting the pricing of an oversubscribed US$700 million (plus up to US$100 million greenshoe) 2.25% convertible senior notes due 2031, issued in a Rule 144A private offering. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, convertible initially at ~US$27.40/share (32.5% premium over the US$20.68 closing price). Settlement is scheduled for June 9, 2026; net proceeds (est. US$675.9M) will partly fund capped call transactions, refinance ~US$50M debt, and support working capital. This is a routine capital markets financing—not a transformative special situation—so no activist, M&A, or restructuring event is present. Risk-arb: irrelevant; monitor conversion premium and redemption triggers after July 2029.
